correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, expanding U after one update cancels both old transverse coordinates, and from n=2 the current transverse values are two past sines, so |U_n−z_n|≤|β|+|β+γ|. Outside the threshold, each signed increment is at least |α|−|κ|; inside or at the threshold solving x=y=sin z and α+κ sin z=0 gives the stated fixed points (and invariant point masses), including α=κ=0. Compactly supported invariant probability would have forward-invariant support for a continuous map. At nonzero equality the signed drift is |α|(1−cos(z−ζ)), so signed U either diverges or has finite limit. In the latter case its increments vanish, giving sin z_n→s, then x_n,y_n→s, and the exact relation with U gives convergence of z_n on the real lift. Integrating the drift forces an invariant compact probability onto sin z=s and invariance of the shifts forces x=y=s; compactness allows only finitely many lattice atoms. The derivative has simple center eigenvalue 1 and nilpotent stable block. Theorem 2.1 of van den Berg–Hetebrij–Rink applies for any specified finite k≥3 via cutoff and a stable-block norm smaller than one, without invertibility of the stable block. Local graph invariance at r'=r+O(r²) forces both graph jets to be −s r²/2+O(r³). Hence r'=r+αr²/2+O(r³). On αr<0 sufficiently small, sign is preserved, |r| decreases to zero, and the reciprocal variable −2/(αr) has increments tending to one, giving the exact limit. For the coexistence replay the two choices x=y=sin z=−1 or +1 give third-coordinate increments 0 or 2π at α=β=γ=δ=π. No frozen code was executed or needed for these exact checks.
residual_risks: No C^∞ existence or uniqueness is asserted. The branch limit does not assert the rate of all convergent starts, and coexistence does not assert a positive velocity for all escaping starts.

checked_sources: Repaired RESULT.md: Finding and proofs of drift, boundary dichotomy, center law and exact coexistence
value.rationale: Unit feedback is the natural slice where affine drift can balance periodic kicks and where local observations cannot distinguish compact motion from translation of the real lift. The global dichotomy, exact coexistence at the same positive parameters, and center-branch rate resolve different aspects of that ambiguity. This is more than a fixed-point census or a trajectory simulation.
residual_risks: The conclusions do not characterize interior bounded dynamics or cover general self-feedback.
